missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Танк' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Тяжёлый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'этот' points at it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Танк' is the accusative object of 'увидели'; as an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Старый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Танка' is the genitive singular after the negated 'нет'. 'Такого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Танку' is the dative singular after 'к', expressing approach toward the tank. 'Инженер' is the nominative subject.

missions.phrase: Дети играют в танк во дворе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative in a game phrase. 'Танк' is the accusative after 'в' in 'играть в', here matching the nominative. 'Во дворе' adds the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Танком' is the instrumental singular after 'за', expressing position behind the tank. 'Машина' is the nominative subject of 'ехала'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Танке' is the prepositional singular after 'о', expressing the topic. 'В музее' adds the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Танки' is the accusative plural, identical to the nominative plural for this inanimate noun, as the object of 'показали'. 'Новые' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantity word. 'Танков' is the genitive plural after 'много'. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в армии' locates them.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after preposition. 'Танками' is the instrumental plural after 'между', expressing position among the tanks. 'Солдаты' is the nominative plural subject.
